pending.act: Choose the interview answers, draft the plan and sign the interview
commands: rig-create interview-answer rig_type --set evidence/interview/rig_type.json --sha256 <sha256 of evidence/interview/rig_type.json> --by user --pick rig_type=keep
rig-create interview-answer reference --set evidence/interview/reference.json --sha256 <sha256 of evidence/interview/reference.json> --by user --pick reference=keep

rig-create interview-answer seethrough --set evidence/interview/seethrough.json --sha256 <sha256 of evidence/interview/seethrough.json> --by user --pick layers=keep --pick resolution=keep --pick head_crop=keep --pick seed=keep

rig-create interview-answer assemble --set evidence/interview/assemble.json --sha256 <sha256 of evidence/interview/assemble.json> --by user --pick projection=keep --pick cut=keep --pick emphasis=keep --pick draw_order=keep --pick authored=keep --pick occluders=keep --pick outfits=keep

rig-create plan add seethrough --by agent --phase rig --order 1 --does Execute synthetic seethrough --produces Synthetic seethrough output --rests-on seethrough --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed false

rig-create plan add assemble --by agent --phase rig --order 2 --does Execute synthetic assemble --produces Synthetic assemble output --rests-on assemble --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed true

rig-create plan add bones --by agent --phase rig --order 3 --does Execute synthetic bones --produces Synthetic bones output --rests-on bones --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed false

rig-create plan add meshes --by agent --phase rig --order 4 --does Execute synthetic meshes --produces Synthetic meshes output --rests-on meshes --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed false

rig-create plan add constraints --by agent --phase rig --order 5 --does Execute synthetic constraints --produces Synthetic constraints output --rests-on constraints --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed false

rig-create plan add motion --by agent --phase rig --order 6 --does Execute synthetic motion --produces Synthetic motion output --rests-on motion --bar The synthetic output matches its declared input. --checkpoint-proposed false
